calls.title: GrowthBook & Stradivarius Support Session
calls.summary: The meeting emphasized the early-stage adoption of Growth Book for feature flagging and experimentation, highlighting usage over the past three months. The migration from Optimizely aims to enhance A/B testing for the Stradivarius and Inditex brands. Around 10 tech leads, along with product owners, are expected to utilize Growth Book, with a strong emphasis on formal training to maximize its experimentation capabilities. Key technical needs discussed included SQL customization for metrics, with the Growth Book team acknowledging the feedback for product enhancement. Communication improvements were proposed, including setting up a dedicated Teams channel for ongoing support and feedback. Overall, the focus is on fostering a long-term partnership across Inditex brands to ensure effective adoption and utilization of Growth Book.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Feature Flagging, Experimentation, SQL Customization, Visual Editor, Enterprise Support
calls.action_items:
